issues.on_page: Budgetary Comparison Schedule, Business-Type Activities: Electric actual 854,534 (budget 1,354,900); Sewer 24,234 (budget 21,550); Water 105,315 (budget 120,400)
issues.issue: [fixed] The business-type funds have no other detail schedule. The rules say to record the budget schedule's lines for every fund without a more detailed schedule, including each utility fund, so these three lines belong in detail (fund_type business-type, section expenditure, category utilities, detail_category not itemized, with budget_final). They are 'Disbursements and Transfers', so the Electric transfer (62,013) is probably inside its line; flag that with review. The extractor left out the whole budget schedule.

issues.on_page: Schedule of Expenditures - Governmental Funds, Total column (Personal Services 121,053; Contracted Services 70,350; Materials and Supplies 126,143; Other Operating Expenses 226,802)
issues.issue: 544,348 of detail spending is in category other because only the Total column was recorded. The fund columns (General, Road, Lottery, Ambulance, Garbage, Fire Hall, Police, Library) each have a clear function, so recording them per fund would give real functions. The 8 columns are over the 6-fund cap, which makes this a judgment call. Applies to detail[0]-detail[3].

issues.on_page: Total (all 8 governmental funds, including General and Road)
issues.issue: The label is misleading: the Total column covers all governmental funds, major funds included, not only nonmajor ones.

issues.on_page: Debt Service 10,306 (Road Fund p16; Total p17); Road Fund principal 6,820 / interest 3,486 on p7
issues.issue: The split comes from the fund statement (p7) and not from the schedule itself. It is defensible because it is the same Road Fund money, but check it.

issues.on_page: Statement of Cash Flows - Proprietary Funds Totals: operating 89,968; noncapital financing (23,901); capital and related (106,286); investing 13,046; beginning 596,152; ending 568,979
issues.issue: The business-type funds are reported on the accrual basis and a proprietary cash-flow statement is printed, but proprietary is null because basis = cash. This is a schema judgment call.
